commandText:
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "StationOperations" AS "s"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyDemands" AS "j" ON "s"."DemandId" = "j"."DemandId"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyRuntimes" AS "j0" ON "j"."JourneyId" = "j0"."JourneyId"
    WHERE "j0"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "s"."Status" = 'RecoveryRequired')

SELECT "r"."CommandMessageId"
FROM "RecoveryWorkflows" AS "r"
WHERE "r"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "r"."CommandMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND "r"."State" <> 'Reconciled' AND "r"."State" <> 'HistoricalOnly'

SELECT "p"."MessageId", "p"."AcknowledgedAt", "p"."CreatedAt", "p"."FencedAt", "p"."MessageType", "p"."PayloadJson"
FROM "ProtocolOutbox" AS "p"
WHERE "p"."MessageType" = 'ExceptionRecoverySessionSnapshot' AND "p"."AcknowledgedAt" IS NULL AND "p"."FencedAt" IS NULL

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "StationOperations" AS "s"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyDemands" AS "j" ON "s"."DemandId" = "j"."DemandId"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyRuntimes" AS "j0" ON "j"."JourneyId" = "j0"."JourneyId"
    WHERE "j0"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "s"."Status" = 'RecoveryRequired')

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "SessionRecoveries" AS "s"
    WHERE "s"."Readiness" = 'Ready')

SELECT "j"."JourneyId", "j"."Sequence", "j"."ConsumedSafetyResultMessageId", "j"."CreatedAt", "j"."LegType", "j"."LoadRound", "j"."MovementLegId", "j"."PlanMessageId", "j"."PlanRevision", "j"."PreDepartureSafetyCheckId", "j"."PreDepartureSafetyCheckMessageId", "j"."Role", "j"."RouteEvidenceId", "j"."State", "j"."StationId", "j"."StationRiotId", "j"."SublotWaitStartedAt", "j"."UpdatedAt", "j"."UpperId", "j"."VehicleBusinessMessageId", "j"."VehicleBusinessRevision", "j"."WorklistRevision"
FROM "JourneyStops" AS "j"
WHERE "j"."JourneyId" = @__journey_JourneyId_0 AND "j"."Sequence" = @__journey_CurrentStopSequence_1
LIMIT 2

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "StationOperations" AS "s"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyDemands" AS "j" ON "s"."DemandId" = "j"."DemandId"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyRuntimes" AS "j0" ON "j"."JourneyId" = "j0"."JourneyId"
    WHERE "j0"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "s"."Status" = 'RecoveryRequired')

SELECT "r"."CommandMessageId"
FROM "RecoveryWorkflows" AS "r"
WHERE "r"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "r"."CommandMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND "r"."State" <> 'Reconciled' AND "r"."State" <> 'HistoricalOnly'

SELECT "p"."MessageId", "p"."AcknowledgedAt", "p"."CreatedAt", "p"."FencedAt", "p"."MessageType", "p"."PayloadJson"
FROM "ProtocolOutbox" AS "p"
WHERE "p"."MessageType" = 'ExceptionRecoverySessionSnapshot' AND "p"."AcknowledgedAt" IS NULL AND "p"."FencedAt" IS NULL

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "StationOperations" AS "s"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyDemands" AS "j" ON "s"."DemandId" = "j"."DemandId"
    INNER JOIN "JourneyRuntimes" AS "j0" ON "j"."JourneyId" = "j0"."JourneyId"
    WHERE "j0"."AgvId" = @__agvId_0 AND "s"."Status" = 'RecoveryRequired')

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "SessionRecoveries" AS "s"
    WHERE "s"."Readiness" = 'Ready')
